home.lookupBody: Open one ballot with its access code. The page does not change the ballot. Checking a published chain does not require this app.
home.passphraseHint: Only a mail-in ballot needs the viewing passphrase.

lookup.title: Ballot lookup
lookup.demonstration: This is a demonstration. It has no legal effect.
lookup.openBody: The code stays on this page until you leave or clear it. It is not put in the address.
lookup.recorded: Type: {{type}}. Sealed {{time}}. A recorded ballot cannot be edited.
lookup.statementHint: Optional. Describe what does not match what you voted.

voter.title: Check your ballot
voter.intro: Open the ballot recorded for you with its access code. This page reads the public record and cannot change it.
voter.footer: This lookup has no sign-in and sets no cookies. Checking a published chain does not require this site.
